_comment: The SqlDataProducer result set of tests/mock/fixtures/asmx.paging.sqldataproducer.json, with
every cell carried as a JSON STRING - the shape issue #120 reports from a real tenant, and the
shape the typed mock fixture cannot reproduce. Nothing but the value types differs: same
Evidence for this shape: the jQGrid population web service renders cells for a grid rather than
returning typed SQL values. Issue #95 pinned the same endpoint family returning 'When' as a
server-formatted DISPLAY STRING ('8/25/2026 12:03 PM') where the committed fixture has an ISO
timestamp - so the committed fixtures are idealised, and the live payload is text.
Deleted is carried as 'False'/'True' here and as '0'/'1' in the Flagged column, because a bit
rendered to text can arrive either way and both have to end up as 1/0.
Code is the leading-zero column of acceptance criterion 2: it must stay quoted whatever else is
promoted, which on untyped data is the whole point.
